title: Springfield, MA — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Springfield, MA: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Springfield is a city in MA with a population of 155,000. Birthplace of basketball with the Basketball Hall of Fame and the Dr. Seuss Museum. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 33.7.
